title: AI4AnimationPy: Python Framework for Intelligent Character Animation
summary: A Python-native framework developed by Meta Research for AI-driven character animation, unifying data processing, training, and real-time visualization. It eliminates the need for game engines like Unity by using a pure NumPy and PyTorch backend with a built-in Raylib renderer.
research_notes: Features an Entity-Component-System (ECS) architecture and supports motion data serialization into high-performance .npz formats from GLB, FBX, and BVH sources.

evolution.summary: The project is the direct successor to the Unity-dependent AI4Animation framework. It transitions the entire pipeline to Python, supporting advanced techniques like Flow Matching and Codebook Matching while allowing backpropagation through the inference and visualization steps.
